Hi Susan,

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the attachments. Sorry youre hitting that error. I copied Evelyn from Procurement and Rafael from Sales Ops so we can troubleshoot quickly.

Couple quick asks so we narrow this down:
- can you confirm whether you clicked the accept link or tried to create an account manually on coupa?
- was the invite sent to accounts-payable@greenwave.energy or another address?

Next steps from our side: Evelyn will try reissuing the invite and Rafael will open a support case with Coupa if needed. If the portal wont accept the invite we can provision an account manually and send a one-time setup link.

We should have an update within 3-4 hours.

Best,

Evelyn, Marissa,

I opened a ticket with Coupa support: INC-20260215-9876 (link below) noting the invite acceptance flow stalls with an account not recognized error. Coupa suggested we try the following in parallel:
1) resend the invite to the same AP address (accounts-payable@greenwave.energy)
2) create a temporary local user on Coupa admin for accounts-payable@greenwave.energy so they can complete onboarding
3) if that fails, provide a one-time SSO/one-time-link from Coupa support

I attached the GreenWave W9 from Susan to the HubSpot record and added a note on the PO process and net-45 payment term request. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/companies/76543

If we reissue the invite please include the note asking AP to try an incognito window and to clear browser cache. If no response within 24 hours we escalate to Coupa account manager for a manual provisioning.

Coupa ticket: https://support.coupa.com/ticket/INC-20260215-9876

Rafael Mendes
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment added: GreenWave_W9.pdf (pdf)
From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:47:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier portal access restored - Redwood Inference

Hi Susan,

Following our troubleshooting, Ive manually provisioned a temporary supplier account for accounts-payable@greenwave.energy and re-sent the portal invite. You should receive an email from coupa-noreply@coupa.com with subject youre invited to join Redwood Inferences Supplier Portal. Please try the following if you still see an error:
- open link in an incognito/private browser window
- clear browser cache and cookies, then retry
- try from a different network in case of corporate proxy restrictions

If you still cant log in, reply and Ill escalate directly with Coupa account management. Once youre in, please upload the W9 and add bank details for PO processing. Ive also recorded the net-45 payment term request in the vendor profile.

Thanks for your patience and welcome aboard GreenWave.

Evelyn Hart
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
PO next steps: PO will be raised after vendor profile completes and W9 is verified.
